provenance.changes: Selected official municipality CD6101, simplified for display, and clipped to the stock Nord-Kivu province.
provenance.note: The overlay shows the documented opening AFC/M23 civilian administration within the portion of Goma municipality that lies inside the stock province. Stock geography retains 80% of the city boundary area after clipping.
